instructions: Init with --projects listing every user-requested project ID. Before freezing, fill one project/candidate entry for each ID and at least one check for each required dimension per project. Checks use project-prefixed unique IDs and include projectId, candidateId, dimension, page, route, component, cardFamily, viewport, state, rule, ruleSource, nonempty samples and expected result. Explain out-of-scope and role absence; missing capabilities remain not-run. The checker reconciles declared scope only; an independent human must compare this list with the actual user request and real pages. New task-derived reports have a separate visual density check per module and PC/phone/narrow width; bind sampleCases, observedSamples and group/short/long/last-row evidenceViews. Whole-page or geometry evidence does not replace these.
